identity.source_note: PUBLISHER MIGRATION + archive-encoded. BMC is moving JOSR to Springer Nature Link (journal 13018); the Nov-2025 BMC landing page carries the banner 'BMC is moving to Springer Nature Link' pointing at https://link.springer.com/journal/13018/submission-guidelines, which is Cloudflare/Akamai bot-blocked. Encoded via Apify rag-web-browser HEADLESS render of BMC Wayback ARCHIVE snapshots (BMC submission content is journal-specific and unchanged by the platform migration): general formatting https://web.archive.org/web/20250526151157/https://josr-online.biomedcentral.com/submission-guidelines/preparing-your-manuscript (26 May 2025); Research https://web.archive.org/web/20250624070817/https://josr-online.biomedcentral.com/submission-guidelines/preparing-your-manuscript/research (24 Jun 2025); Review https://web.archive.org/web/20250624070852/https://josr-online.biomedcentral.com/submission-guidelines/preparing-your-manuscript/review ; Systematic reviews https://web.archive.org/web/20250624070827/https://josr-online.biomedcentral.com/submission-guidelines/preparing-your-manuscript/systematic-reviews ; landing https://web.archive.org/web/20251116141214/https://josr-online.biomedcentral.com/submission-guidelines (16 Nov 2025). Article-type snapshots are ~12.6 months old (June 2025).

encoding_notes: PUBLISHER MIGRATION: JOSR is moving from BMC (josr-online.biomedcentral.com) to Springer Nature Link (journal id 13018). guidelines_url points at the live Springer canonical https://link.springer.com/journal/13018/submission-guidelines (Cloudflare/Akamai bot-blocked) for freshness re-checks; actual encoding source is the BMC Wayback snapshots named in source_note (headless render).

Article types accepted (from the 'Preparing your manuscript' sub-page list): Research->original_research; Review->review; Systematic reviews->systematic_review; Correspondence->letter. OMITTED for lack of a clean enum slot: 'Study protocols', 'Methodology', and 'Matters Arising' (Matters Arising is post-publication commentary; Correspondence already occupies the 'letter' slot). JOSR does NOT list Case Report or Case Series as distinct author-submittable article types (case reports are handled within Research and the guide only notes 'All presentations of case reports must have consent for publication').

sections/word_limits only encoded for original_research, review, systematic_review (guide prescribes body-section order for these). 'letter' (Correspondence) sub-page not fetched, so it appears in article_types only. List of abbreviations, Declarations and References follow the body sections for all types but are treated as back-matter, not listed in the sections array.

abstract.sections reflects the primary type (Research/Systematic review): Background, Methods, Results, Conclusions, Trial registration (Trial registration conditional on RCTs). Review abstract differs: unstructured 'background, main body of the abstract and short conclusion', also capped 350 words. Guide: 'The Abstract should not exceed 350 words.'

line_spacing='double' from 'Use double line spacing'. page_numbers.show=true and line numbering required from 'Include line and page numbering'; guide does NOT specify continuous vs per-page for line numbers, so line_numbers='continuous' is the standard BMC/Springer interpretation (schema has no null option). Guide also states 'Do not use page breaks in your manuscript'.

page_size=null: guide references 'A4 or Letter' interchangeably for table/figure sizing but prescribes no single page size. font family/size, margins, alignment, first_line_indent, headings all UNSTATED in the general formatting guide -> null. No running head required (unstated).

references: in_text='bracket' from 'Reference citations in the text should be identified by numbers in square brackets.' order='cited' from 'The entries in the list should be numbered consecutively.' style='vancouver' ('Examples of the Vancouver reference style are shown below'). journal_abbrev='nlm' from 'Journal abbreviations follow Index Medicus/MEDLINE.' include_doi=true (reference examples show DOI form 'doi:10.1007/...'). et_al_threshold=6 derived from the guide's own example listing exactly 6 authors then 'et al.' (Rohrmann S, Overvad K, Bueno-de-Mesquita HB, Jakobsen MU, Egeberg R, Tjonneland A, et al.) — not from explicit prose. in_text_punctuation and max_count unstated -> null.

tables: placement='in_text' ('Tables less than one A4 or Letter page in length can be placed in the appropriate location within the manuscript'; larger tables at end of text file). caption_position='above' ('Table titles (max 15 words) should be included above the table, and legends (max 300 words) should be included underneath the table'). numbering='arabic' ('Arabic numerals (i.e. Table 1, Table 2 etc.)').

figures: separate_files=true ('Figures should be numbered in the order they are first mentioned in the text, and uploaded in this order'; individual figure files <=10 MB). min_dpi=300 ('image resolution of approximately 300 dpi (dots per inch) at the final size'). legends_location='in_text' ('Figure titles (max 15 words) and legends (max 300 words) should be provided in the main manuscript, not in the graphic file' — inline vs dedicated-section not specified). Accepted formats listed: EPS, PDF, Microsoft Word, PowerPoint, TIFF, JPEG, PNG, BMP, CDX — enum records only eps/pdf/tiff/jpeg/png (Word/PowerPoint/BMP/CDX have no enum slot). callout_style and naming_pattern unstated -> null.

declarations: all seven listed subheadings are mandatory ('All manuscripts must contain the following sections under the heading Declarations ... If any of the sections are not relevant ... include the heading and write Not applicable'). Order + mapping: Ethics approval and consent to participate->ethics_approval; Consent for publication->patient_consent; Availability of data and materials->data_availability; Competing interests->conflict_of_interest; Funding->funding; Authors' contributions->author_contributions; Acknowledgements->acknowledgments. 'Authors' information (optional)' has no enum slot and is optional -> omitted. trial_registration is carried in the abstract's 'Trial registration' section rather than the Declarations block.

blinding all-false: peer-review-policy sub-page not separately fetched, but the title page (full author names + institutional addresses + corresponding author) is the first section of a single submitted manuscript with no anonymized version required -> single-blind review, no separate title-page file, no body/metadata scrubbing.

misc: orcid_required=false and cover_letter_required=false (neither stated as required in the reachable guide). highlights_required=false (BMC/JOSR does not use a Highlights element). title_case=null (no title-case rule prescribed; guide only asks the title to indicate study design where appropriate).

Systematic reviews additionally require a populated PRISMA checklist (as an additional file) + PRISMA flow diagram (in the main text), and PROSPERO protocol registration is strongly recommended — no schema field for reporting-checklist requirements, noted here.
LLM/authorship policy: Large Language Models do not satisfy authorship criteria; LLM use must be documented in the Methods section (guide-wide policy; no schema field).
